text:
```yaml
name: Coffee Bot Lottery Poster
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 1 9 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  post-coffee-lottery:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '17'
          distribution: 'temurin'
      
      - name: Setup Maven
        uses: stCarolas/setup-maven@v5
        with:
          maven-version: '3.8.6'
      
      - name: Configure Git user
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "coffee-bot"
          git config --global user.email "coffee-bot@users.noreply.github.com"
      
      - name: Run coffee bot
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          MCP_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.MCP_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          mvn clean compile exec:java -Dexec.mainClass="com.nagisa77.openisle.CoffeeBot" -Dexec.args="post-lottery"
```
